title: The cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway
objective: Explain how the efferent vagus limits inflammation via acetylcholine and the spleen.

steps.title: How the brake works
steps.body: The efferent arm is the **[[cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway]]**: vagal output leads to acetylcholine acting on immune cells — notably spleen macrophages — to reduce their release of inflammatory cytokines like TNF. Rosas-Ballina et al. showed a surprising relay through acetylcholine-making T cells.

flag.note: The circuit (vagus → splenic nerve → ACh-producing T cells → macrophages) is still being worked out; details and the exact anatomy are debated.

steps.prompt: At the end of the cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway, what happens to macrophages?
options: Acetylcholine signaling reduces their release of inflammatory cytokines
They are triggered to release far more TNF than they usually would
Acetylcholine kills the macrophages outright, which lowers the cytokines
They begin conducting their own action potentials like neurons
steps.explanation: The pathway's output (acetylcholine) acts on macrophages to suppress inflammatory cytokine release — the molecular 'brake' on inflammation.

variants.setup: The efferent vagal pathway engages acetylcholine signaling on spleen macrophages.
variants.prompt: What's the effect on their cytokines?
options: A large increase in cytokine release
variants.reveal: Acetylcholine signaling dampens macrophage cytokine release.

steps.prompt: What was surprising in Rosas-Ballina et al.'s account of this circuit?
options: A type of T cell that makes acetylcholine relays the neural signal
Macrophages grew their own axons to reach all the way to the brain
The spleen turned out to have no role in the pathway at all
Antibodies carried the signal all the way down the vagus nerve
steps.explanation: An acetylcholine-synthesizing T cell was found to relay the neural signal to macrophages — an unexpected neuron–immune handoff that other groups are still testing.

variants.setup: The neural signal has to reach splenic macrophages.
variants.reveal: In their account, ACh-synthesizing T cells relay the signal to macrophages — a step still being worked out.
